import sys, time, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import Job, find_deficient_cut, compile_plan, check_plan

def ring(k, rate, demands):
    links=[(i,(i+1)%k, 10) for i in range(k)]
    return links

def test_ring(k, rate, dem_val):
    links = ring(k, rate, None)
    demands = {i: dem_val for i in range(k)}
    env = {l: rate for l in range(k)}
    job = Job(k, links, demands, 1, env)
    t0=time.monotonic(); cut=find_deficient_cut(job); tc=time.monotonic()-t0
    if cut:
        print(f'ring{k} rate{rate}: DENIED cut {cut[:6]} (tcut {tc:.2f})')
        return
    t0=time.monotonic(); plan=compile_plan(job, budget=25); dt=time.monotonic()-t0
    ok = plan is not None and check_plan(job, plan)
    print(f'ring{k} rate{rate}: plan_ok={ok} time={dt:.2f} trees={len(plan["trees"]) if plan else "-"} routes={len(plan["routes"]) if plan else "-"} nodes={len(plan["recipes"]) if plan else "-"}')
